GetExport: Reads a parked response in memory; no file I/O.
ListExports: Lists in-memory response handles; no file I/O.
ClearExports: Deletes in-memory response handles, not files.
DeleteExport: Deletes an in-memory response handle, not a file.
SaveAsProject: TIA Save As switches the open project and MCP binding (P7-07b finding 48).
GenerateBlocksFromExternalSource: Generates blocks and UDTs into the PLC software and may overwrite existing blocks; apply needs Workbench approval (maintainer 2026-10-11).
ManagePlcDataBlockSnapshot: loadSnapshotAsActualValues and loadStartValuesAsActualValues write values into the running CPU; apply needs Workbench approval (maintainer 2026-10-11).
RunPlcCompanionTool: mode=run may write files, run project tests or write PLC values; apply needs Workbench approval (maintainer 2026-10-11).

CreatePlcTag: Creates a tag in the bound offline PLC project.
CreatePlcTagTable: Creates a tag table in the bound offline PLC project.
CreatePlcUserConstant: Creates a user constant in the bound offline PLC project.
GetPortalConnectionReadiness: Passive connection prerequisites; does not attach.
ListPlcSystemConstants: Reads system constant declarations from the bound project.
ListPlcTags: Reads tag declarations from the bound project.
ListPlcUserConstants: Reads user constant declarations from the bound project.
PlanPlcExternalSourceImport: Plans an external source import; no import execution.
